title: Signalboard: weekly quality telemetry and onboarding regressions
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact weekly ‘signalboard’ focused on the current onboarding cohort and recent regression signals across prompt sets used for model-onboarding evaluations. Aim: surface high-leverage failures, quantify drift, propose immediate mitigations, and hand off clear owners for the next sprint.

Scope and window:
- Time range: 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-15
- Models in scope: open-v8-small (baseline), redwood-chat-1.0 (onboard candidate), quantized variants q8 and q4hx
- Promptset cohort: onboarding-v2 (120 prompts spanning product-help, summarization, and extraction)

Executive summary:
- Net pass rate for onboarding-v2 fell from 88% -> 76% week-over-week (WoW). Largest drops concentrated in extraction prompts (from 92% -> 68%).
- Median latency stable (+4ms) but 95th percentile token generation latency regressed by ~18% on redwood-chat-1.0-q8 during long-context (>1024) prompts.
- Prefix cache hit rate for the onboarding cohort decreased from 41% -> 27% after a runtime change (KV eviction patch deployed 2026-03-11).
- Top three failure modes: truncated fields in structured extraction, hallucinated step-ids in multi-step instructions, and degraded numeric rounding in financial prompts.

Key telemetry (high-level):
- onboarding-v2 pass rate: 76% (baseline expectation >=85%)
- extraction subcategory pass rate: 68% (target >=90%)
- prefix/KV cache hit rate: 27% (prior baseline 41%)
- avg token generation latency (redwood-chat-1.0-q8): 28ms -> 33ms median; 95p 110ms -> 130ms
- model-compare: open-v8-small pass 84% (stable), redwood-chat-1.0 raw 79%, q8 76%, q4hx 64%

Regression heatmap (top signal clusters):
- Cluster A — Structured extraction failures (43% of fails): missing trailing fields, misaligned JSON keys for contact/address extractions.
- Cluster B — Multi-step instruction hallucinations (27%): extra step IDs, invented preconditions. Often triggered by prompts with enumerated lists.
- Cluster C — Numeric precision drift (15%): rounding to fewer decimal places on financial amounts for q4hx variant.
- Cluster D — Long-context token concat truncations (10%): tokens dropped when >1500 token context; correlated with reduced cache hit rate.

Hypotheses and quick checks already run:
1) KV eviction patch (2026-03-11) changed cache window -> explains hit-rate drop and long-context 95p latency increases. Checked: eviction thresholds decreased by 20% in the new runtime build.
2) Quantization changes in q4hx introduced lower numeric fidelity -> explains numeric precision failures. Re-ran exact-float-checks: q4hx deviates on 9/120 prompts beyond tolerance.
3) Promptset drift: new hand-authored examples include nested JSON w/ trailing commas; parser mismatch caused field truncation. Reproduced locally by feeding one failing prompt to the runtime and inspecting tokenizer boundaries.

Immediate mitigation plan (urgent, 72hr):
- Rollback KV eviction thresholds to previous values on a canary pool (owner: Priya K., ETA: 2026-03-18).
- Quarantine q4hx for financial workloads: update onboarding guidance to route numeric-critical prompts to q8/raw (owner: Diego A., ETA: 2026-03-17).
- Add normalization step in prompt ingestion to sanitize trailing commas and ambiguous JSON (owner: Maya C., ETA: 2026-03-19).
- Short-term reroute policy: for any prompt where extraction confidence <0.6, fallback to open-v8-small until fixes land (owner: eng-ops, ETA: 2026-03-17).

Medium-term (2–6 weeks):
- Vet quantization calibration for q4hx on numeric-heavy prompt families; introduce targeted post-quantization numeric tests to CI (owner: applied-ml research, ETA: 2026-04-06).
- Update regression dashboard: add prompt-level diff view (gold vs candidate) and inline failure annotation to speed triage (owner: developer-experience, ETA: 2026-04-01).
- Policy: ensure runtime KV changes require a regression gate on long-context onboarding promptsets (owner: serving-runtime, ETA: 2026-04-09).

Top action items (owner, priority):
- Priya K. (P0): rollout canary rollback of KV eviction and monitor prefix hit & 95p latency for 48h.
- Diego A. (P0): patch onboarding docs to route numeric-exact prompts away from q4hx + update eval configs.
- Maya C. (P1): push prompt ingestion sanitizer and run onboarding-v2 end-to-end sanity.
- Eleni M. (P1): triage top 20 failing extraction prompts; label root cause and add to promptset patch queue.
- eng-ops (P2): add a temporary routing rule to bypass q4hx for requests with financial tag.

Data and artifacts to review (quick links):
- Reg dashboard (live): CONFLUENCE-APPLIED-ML/ONBOARDING-SIGNALBOARD
- Repro cases (notebooks): github.com/redwood-inference/applied-ml/onboarding/repros/2026-03-15
- KV eviction PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/412

Notes to reviewers:
- Prioritize approvals for the KV rollback canary; we have evidence the change correlates tightly with the observed drops.
- The prompt sanitizer is deliberately conservative (strip trailing commas, normalize whitespace) — we need to ensure we don't over-normalize and change user intent.
- For release communication: recommend an internal postmortem-lite if rollback is applied cluster-wide.

Appendix: short reproducer checklist (for on-call/triage):
1) Pull latest staging runtime (tag: staging-2026-03-12).
2) Run repro notebook for extraction-fail-34 with config: model=redwood-chat-1.0-q8, context=1800 tokens.
3) Compare tokenizer offsets and KV cache metrics (prefix_hit, cache_evictions) in the trace output.
4) If prefix_hit < 30% and truncations observed, escalate to Priya K.

End of signalboard.
Please add notes inline in this doc or ping #applied-ml with quick updates.
